evidence: Directly exposes manual pruning and flushing functions in src/kernel/bitcoinkernel.h and src/kernel/bitcoinkernel.cpp, with extensive test coverage in src/test/kernel/test_kernel.cpp.
rationale: Exposes manual pruning and chainstate flushing in libbitcoinkernel, resolving a key limitation where downstream applications cannot open datadirs from pruned nodes. The PR addresses #35627 and downstream demand (kernel-node#111) so external users can manage block storage bounds.
